# QuoteKit IL

> Free, browser-based Hebrew tools: a quote (price offer) calculator with VAT for Israeli freelancers, printable apartment-handover checklists, and short guides. No sign-up; typed data stays in the browser.

Facts:
- The quote tool produces a quote/worksheet, NOT a tax invoice (חשבונית מס). Not legal, engineering or tax advice.
- VAT is a fixed 18% for licensed dealers; exempt dealers get 0.
- The calculator has a Hebrew/English toggle (Hebrew shows only ILS, English only USD). A CSV template (opens in Excel/Google Sheets) is a free download.
- An optional tip via PayPal is offered after print/download and next to the template (Hebrew UI: 1 ILS, English UI: 1 USD).

Pages:
- [Home: all tools](https://scocomakoko.github.io/quotekit-il/): hub listing every tool and guide
- [Quote and VAT calculator](https://scocomakoko.github.io/quotekit-il/quote/): main tool, plus CSV template
- [Apartment checklists](https://scocomakoko.github.io/quotekit-il/dira/): handover, walkthrough, wet rooms, rental condition form, defect list (Hebrew, printable)
- [How to write a quote for a client](https://scocomakoko.github.io/quotekit-il/how-to-write-a-quote.html): Hebrew guide
- [VAT on a quote: licensed vs exempt dealer](https://scocomakoko.github.io/quotekit-il/how-to-calculate-vat-on-a-quote.html): Hebrew explainer
- [What a quote should include](https://scocomakoko.github.io/quotekit-il/what-a-quote-must-include.html): Hebrew checklist
- [Quote vs invoice](https://scocomakoko.github.io/quotekit-il/quote-vs-invoice.html): Hebrew guide, what each document is and when to issue it
- [Renovation quote, worked example](https://scocomakoko.github.io/quotekit-il/renovation-quote-example.html): Hebrew guide, line-by-line example with 18% VAT

More features (all client-side, localStorage only):
- Quote tool: live preview, copy as WhatsApp message or open wa.me link on tap, automatic quote number, customizable quick-add lines, optional remembered business details.
- Checklists: progress ring, per-item flag and note, defect summary, copy remaining items as WhatsApp text, import flagged items into the printable defect list.
- Light and dark themes with a toggle.
